authority: HM Land Registry GOV.UK and Use land and property data

claims.statement: The great majority of registered titles show general boundaries under section 60(1) rather than an exact legal line.
HM Land Registry states that no standard tolerance, measurement or ratio can be attributed between a general boundary on a title plan and the legal boundary.
A determined boundary is separately recorded and is the route for showing an exact line after that line has been identified.
Official title-plan wording warns that the plan shows the general position, may be distorted in scale and scaled measurements may not match the ground.
INSPIRE Index Polygons are an open subset covering freehold registered property rather than all National Polygon records.
INSPIRE polygons show the position and indicative extent of registered property.
Each INSPIRE Index Polygon has a Land Registry-INSPIRE ID relating to a registered title.
The INSPIRE dataset is documented as updated monthly and delivered as GML.
National Polygon title numbers link polygon records to Title Descriptor and UPRN datasets.
Poly_ID is a unique spatial-object reference managed through lifecycle rules.
Vers_No records polygon version and Rec_Status distinguishes Added, Changed and Deleted records.
INSERT records initial creation on the index map and UPDATE records the last update of all or part of the title.
The index map is a computerised map based on Ordnance Survey mapping and indexes registered titles and pending first-registration applications.
HM Land Registry applies internal quality processes but does not guarantee public data is fit for a user's intended purpose.
No current candidate-specific INSPIRE IDs, polygon bytes or authoritative boundary geometry were captured for the three candidate references.
